import java.text.ParseException;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;

/**
 * Pre-2015 helper kept for the nightly extract job. It lives in the default package
 * because the job's shell script loads it by simple name.
 */
public class LegacyDateHelper {

    private static final String PATTERN = "dd/MM/yyyy";

    public static Date parse(final String text) throws ParseException {
        SimpleDateFormat format = new SimpleDateFormat(PATTERN);
        format.setLenient(false);
        return format.parse(text);
    }

    public static String format(final Date date) {
        return new SimpleDateFormat(PATTERN).format(date);
    }
}
